verdict.rationale: Azure's Terraform documentation lists 'Export resources to HCL code', which gives a first-party path for bringing existing resources into Terraform IaC instead of starting greenfield. That is only a single heading-level mention. Nothing in the pack covers drift detection or reconciliation, and nothing shows Bicep or ARM import workflows; the Bicep and ARM docs describe declarative deployment only. Missing for 10: documented drift detection/what-if workflow, Bicep/ARM import or decompile path for existing resources, depth on the export workflow itself, independent or hands-on corroboration.
